statement: The shape-(C) lifting conditions extend to smooth tropical quartics failing the earlier edge-length genericity condition. Among the 1278 unimodular triangulations modulo S3, the numbers admitting real-bitangent count sets {4,8,16,28}, {4,8,28}, {4,16,28}, {8,16,28}, {4,28}, {8,28}, and {16,28} are respectively 1207,15,27,18,6,3,2. In particular every triangulation admits a real lift with 28 bitangents.
